messages:
maria: Quick sync on proposed prompt/prefix caching contract for generation endpoints. Draft proposal below — looking for compatibility concerns and edge cases (streaming, PII, invalidation).

maria: TL;DR: opt-in cache with explicit key + server-supplied headers. Request may include `X-Cache-Key` or we compute from `(model, model_version, prefix_hash, user_namespace)`; server returns `X-Redwood-Cache: hit|miss`, `Cache-Control` (max-age, stale-while-revalidate), and `X-Cache-Reason` for misses.

ajay: prefer query param `?cache=true` rather than silent header as opt-in. headers easy to forget in some SDKs. also: need clear backward-compat — default behavior = no caching unless opt-in.

maria: Agreed default = no-cache. We should support both header and query param for flexibility. SDKs will set both automatically.

devon: Implementation note: streaming responses complicate things. If cached, we'll send the cached full payload as a single precomputed stream chunk and still emit streaming chunks to match client streaming API. We can set `X-Redwood-Cache: hit` in the initial HTTP headers. If we stream from a cache chunked, need to maintain identical SSE framing.

kim: PII concern: prefix may contain user data. Rule: any request with `Cache-Control: no-store` from client OR header `X-Contains-Personal: true` should force no-cache. Also we should never cache responses for prompts flagged with `sensitive=true` in body.

sam: For invalidation: two strategies: 1) explicit invalidation endpoint `POST /v1/cache/invalidate` with list of cache-keys (auth required), 2) server-side automatic invalidation on model_version bump (we should include `cache_key_v1` derived from model+prefix_hash+config_hash). Recommend both.

ajay: +1 on explicit invalidation. Also propose `X-Cache-Tag` header(s) so we can invalidate by tag (e.g., `system_prompts:v2`) instead of raw keys.

maria: Good call — add `X-Cache-Tag` support. We'll wire invalidation by tag or key.

devon: Suggest `X-Redwood-Cache` values: `hit`, `miss`, `bypassed` (when client requested no-store), `stale` (served stale while revalidating). Also include `X-Cache-TTL` in seconds for diagnostics.

kim: How about cache control semantics? Server will return `Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600, stale-while-revalidate=60` when safe. If `no-store`, server returns `Cache-Control: no-store`. Document will list exact directives we support.

maria: Backcompat plan: stage 1 (opt-in header/param) -> stage 2 (SDKs enable for non-sensitive templates) -> stage 3 (deprecate earlier ad-hoc caching). Deprecation window: 90 days.

sam: Add a cache audit log for requests that were cached/hit (redwood-infra). We need this for compliance and debugging.

cache-bot: Added ticket REDWOOD-1427 to infra backlog: "prompt-prefix caching primitives (headers + invalidation + audit logs)" — assigned to eng-infra.

ajay: One more: how do we compute prefix_hash? canonicalize whitespace + normalize placeholders (e.g., `{{user}}` -> `{{USER}}`) then SHA256. Need deterministic rules in doc.

devon: Also note: for multi-turn chat where prefix changes mid-conversation, we only cache per-request using provided prefix. If client wants conversation-level caching, they must supply stable `X-Cache-Key`.

maria: OK action items:
- devon: prototype header emisssion + streaming behavior (spike 2d)
- ajay: add query-param opt-in and SDK changes (PR)
- kim: write security appendix re: PII/no-store rules
- sam: design invalidation API and audit log schema
- infra: REDWOOD-1427 (cache backend + tags)

maria: I'll draft a formal API doc (contract + examples) after we have the spike results. If anyone has immediate blockers or must-have constraints, flag them here. :slightly_smiling_face:

ajay: nit — spelling: emisssion -> emission ;-)

maria: thanks, fixed in notes.
